description.value: The Civic Centre Arena is Nelson's community ice facility, home to ice hockey and public skating in the heart of downtown. Operated by the Regional District of Central Kootenay, it serves as a hub for local recreation. Touring cyclists passing through Nelson may find it a useful landmark near the downtown core.
